blocks.text: Relax in modern comfort with our Acanva sectional sofa that features match your will. This modern L-shape sofa is upholstered in a soft and elegant velvet fabric to lounge in complete comfort. Its thick seat cushions, pillows, solid wood frame, and rubber legs provide maximum supportive coziness. Comfortably seats 4 to 5 people making this velvet modular sectional sofa a perfect seating space for your living room or office.

items: Modern design - Our minimalist modular sectional sofa featuring smooth velvet fabric and sleek, curved lines that add an appealing touch to your living space. The L-shape 4 seater corner couch with movable ottoman design makes it suitable for relaxing with your family.

Dive in comfort - Enjoy ultimate comfort with this living room sofa's high-resilience foam filling that makes the cushions fluffy and provides optimal support. It also comes with two extra pillows to add increased comfort when sitting for long periods or watching a movie.

Sturdy and functional - Built with quality larch wood and a spring-reinforced frame, this cloud velvet sofa is both sturdy and functional. The velvet fabric is perfect for daily use and can be easily spot-cleaned to ensure long-lasting usage.

Spacious seating - With a capacity of 1200 lbs, this modern reversible sofa set includes a chaise, a right-arm seater and an ottoman, providing spacious seating for up to 4 adults. It measures 116”W x 62”D x 26.4”H.
Easy assembly - Assembly is hassle-free and can be completed in 10 minutes or less. This sofa sectional for living room is perfect for apartments, dormitories, studios, and offices.

Product Care Instructions
items.value: DIY solution - small amount of dish soap or washing detergent mixed with water, For Dry Stains, a vacuum with a small attachment makes it easier to clean, For Wet Stains, soak up any excess moisture via dry cloth asap; spot-test any water-based fabric cleaner first to avoid damage; apply to the stained area and rub slowly and gently to remove the stain; air dry completely before use, For scratches, light marks can be removed with a soft clothes brush, brushing gently in the direction of the nap. Heavier or stubborn marks can be removed with a suede brush.
